rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１９Hey there.￥Mind if I come in for a sec?
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２０You've been really into your￥training lately. Going well?＝＠２０７＿０２１You seem to be working super￥hard, so I wondered how you￥were doing.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２２Man, you really love￥training, huh?
Not really.
Is there a problem?
Not really.
Is there a problem?
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２３Huh? If you didn't love it,￥I doubt you could beat an￥expert's scores.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２４I never said there was￥anything wrong with it.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２５I'm just impressed, that's all.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２６I figured you were doing some￥secret training on your days￥off or something.＝＠２０７＿０２７But from the look of you, you￥only train during regular hours.＝＠２０７＿０２８And you still beat me...
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０２９At this rate, won't you end￥up an expert in everything?
Yep, that's the plan.
No way. Impossible.
Yes, that's the plan.
No way. Impossible.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０３０Pretty confident, huh...￥Well, not my problem. Knock￥yourself out.＝＠２０７＿０３１Just don't let me pass you￥again while you're busy with￥everything else.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０３２For someone who loves training,￥that should be easy, right?
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００１It's not just me--experts are￥all touchy about their own￥specialties, you know.
＊Yoh＊＠２０４＿００２Losing to someone who doesn't￥even specialize in it? They'd be￥pretty ticked off.＝＠２０４＿００３You're the one being chased now,￥so hang in there.￥See ya.
